loops.workflow: PIPELINE (Idan 2026-09-29): job ends at PR-open — record handoff in JSON, immediately start next slice in fresh worktree. GLOBAL WIP CAP (Idan 2026-09-29, replaces per-loop cap of 2 as the hard rule): NEVER more than 4 open PRs repo-wide. Before opening any PR, count via gh pr list --state open --jq length; if count == 4, stop feature dev and help land open PRs (review fixups, rebase help, chase CI), re-check periodically, open when count < 4. Per-loop max 2 open PRs remains a hygiene guideline. Merges strict FIFO oldest-first via the merge-pipeline agent — NEVER merge your own PRs. Claim discipline: verify no other loop JSON / open PR claims a slice before starting. Delete merged slice worktrees after confirming merge. Blocked slices: record reason, move on. last_evidence_at bumps on genuine phase transitions only (slice claimed/started, real-diff checkpoint, push, PR open, review received, merge confirmed) — never on keepalive heartbeats.
